text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - multiple continuous-batcher pods in us-east-1b have SIGKILL / OOM exit. Autoscaler is flapping. See alert: https://alerts.internal/redwood/2987654321

sara_oncall: seeing huge P95/P99 latency for text-gen routes, multiple 5xx and client timeouts. UI shows spike ~09:04 UTC.

james_dev: I can repro locally with a long-context job triggering batch growth. Attaching recent runtime log snippet.

james_dev: ```
E0305 09:03:59.123 runtime.cpp:542] EV: batcher.cpp: grow_loop: kv_cache_growth -> 1.2x
E0305 09:04:01.456 cuda:0 SIGKILL (out-of-memory) pid=27432
E0305 09:04:02.002 kube: pod continuous-batcher-xyz terminated with code 137
```

tara_sre: copying logs to /tmp/incident-2987654321 for post-incident. For now: can we throttle prefetch or disable KV prefetch quickly? That has helped before.

kevin_runtime: I can patch config to reduce max_batch_size and disable prefetch. Doing a quick patch via kubectl.

kevin_runtime: `kubectl -n runtime patch configmap continuous-batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"6","kv_prefetch_enabled":"false"}}'`

ops-bot: Rollout started: patch applied to us-east-1b continuous-batcher DaemonSet - rollout id r-2987.

support_lead: Support: we have three customers reporting increased latency and 502s. CS is triaging and offering status updates. No major revenue impact confirmed yet but one enterprise job timed out.

sara_oncall: after patch latency is improving for a subset of traffic, P95 down from ~3.8s to ~700ms on one node. But one node still flapping and getting OOM on restart.

james_dev: I'm going to drain the node with repeated SIGKILLs and force a repro on a dev pool. `kubectl drain ip-10-0-45-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

tara_sre: draining now, marking node unschedulable in the fleet. Also opening manual cordon to prevent new batchers from landing.

incident-bot: Note: automatic fallback to small-model variants triggered for 4% of traffic while we stabilize (policy: emergency-fallback).

kevin_runtime: Confirmed: the culprit was a runaway batch accumulator where a rare token pattern caused the continuous-batcher to keep merging requests into growing batches beyond the configured max when KV prefetch queue backed up. Creating a hotfix branch.

james_dev: Hotfix plan: 1) revert aggressive prefetching behavior, 2) enforce hard upper bound on batch size inside runtime (defensive), 3) add circuit to drop prefetch tasks if growth > threshold. I'll push a canary build to staging.

ops-bot: Canary build r-2987-canary deployed to staging pool.

support_lead: CS: sent an update to impacted customers noting degraded performance and mitigation steps. Holding for further updates before drafting public status.

sara_oncall: handoff in 30m to overnight oncall. Current mitigation: kv_prefetch disabled, max_batch_size lowered, one node cordoned; cluster CPU still elevated but stable.

tara_sre: collecting heap/profile on one crashed pod for postmortem. Uploading to artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/2987654321/heap-dump.tgz

james_dev: pushed runtime hotfix branch: github.com/redwood/runtime@hotfix/2987-batch-guard. Two quick unit tests added for batch_accumulator and prefetch backpressure.

kevin_runtime: rolling hotfix to canary small fleet (5 pods) in us-east-1b; if green after 10m we'll roll to primary.

incident-bot: Checkpoint: mitigations applied, customer impact reduced. Severity being evaluated for potential downgrade.

support_lead: tally: 3 customers affected, 1 job timed out, no data loss. CS will follow up with SOC tickets.

sara_oncall: handing off to tara_sre for overnight. Please monitor for node flaps and any SIGKILL recurrence. If one of the nodes re-occurs, escalate to infra and consider temporary capacity scale-up.

tara_sre: ack. I'll own the rest of the night and coordinate final rollout in the morning. Will include postmortem notes and recommended config changes: default prefetch off, stricter runtime batch hard cap, and an alert for batch_accumulator growth rate.

james_dev: quick note for postmortem: add a unit test fuzz harness that simulates interleaved prefetch + long-context to catch accumulator growth.

sara_oncall: thanks team. closing the realtime thread; will create a follow-up ticket for postmortem and SLA impact analysis. :white_check_mark:
